# Package: sdk

## Purpose

Type-safe API client for `@club-manager/api`. Auto-generated from the OpenAPI 3.0 spec.

## How it works

```
apps/api/openapi.json   ← source of truth (generated by NestJS + @nestjs/swagger)
        ↓ openapi-typescript
packages/sdk/src/schema.ts   ← generated TypeScript types (DO NOT EDIT)
        ↓ openapi-fetch (runtime)
packages/sdk/src/index.ts    ← configured client (safe to edit)
```

## CRITICAL: Do not edit `src/schema.ts`

`src/schema.ts` is **fully auto-generated** from `openapi.json`. Any manual changes will be overwritten on the next `generate` run.

## Regenerating the SDK

Whenever the API adds or changes endpoints:

```bash
# From the repo root:
pnpm generate:sdk

# Or step by step:
pnpm --filter @club-manager/api build:openapi   # writes apps/api/openapi.json
pnpm --filter @club-manager/sdk generate         # regenerates src/schema.ts
```

## Using the SDK

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@club-manager/sdk';

// List clubs
const { data, error } = await apiClient.GET('/api/clubs');

// Create a club
const { data, error } = await apiClient.POST('/api/clubs', {
  body: { name: 'FC Example', city: 'Madrid' },
});
```

All request/response types are inferred automatically from the OpenAPI schema.

## Authentication

Call `setAuthToken(token)` to attach a Bearer token to all subsequent requests:

```typescript
import { setAuthToken } from '@club-manager/sdk';
setAuthToken(myJwtToken);
```

## Building

```bash
pnpm --filter @club-manager/sdk build   # produces dist/
```
